label: first input token is t (step 0)
explanation: Fires exactly when the input at step 0 (the first original token) is the letter t, and nowhere else. On the dev split, predicate (t==0)&(in_tok==t) gives precision = recall = F1 = 1.0 with zero misses and zero false positives. Activation is constant (0.049 on every active step), so nothing modulates its size: L, digit count and the later tokens have no effect. It does NOT fire on t at any later original position, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase, including when t is being output at recall_idx 0.
